message: Replace example.com manifest URLs and empty codeowners before publishing. Version 0.0.0 is a scaffold placeholder, not an approved release version.
The scaffold has no setup, config flow, API calls, or entities. Obtain implementation plan approval before adding runtime logic.
No Git repository or remote exists at scaffold creation. Configure the repository before applying dev backup and push procedures.
The user approved local dev commit backups instead of remote pushes for the 0.1.0 development task. Initial scaffold backup commit: 11d89df.

Current KakaoMap REST API documentation requires a coordinate/radius or rectangle search scope. Version 0.1.0 uses a Korea-area rectangle, and address input remains keyword place search, not address geocoding.
Version 0.1.0 supersedes the scaffold version placeholder. Repository URLs and codeowners still require actual repository information before HACS publishing.

Kakao routing uses longitude for x and latitude for y. Transit landingURL differs in capitalization from walk/bicycle landingUrl. Duration is seconds, distance is meters, and fares are KRW. Route geometry is intentionally omitted from conversation summaries.

Only documented no-result statuses yield an empty routes list. Other routing failures are HA action errors. Route duration is not real-time bus arrival data. Local dev backup exception remains in use for this continuation.

HA response actions do not automatically create an LLM provider. Register a llm.API, expose namespaced ToolResult-returning tools, and unregister with the config entry lifecycle. Avoid naming the imported HA helper llm in package __init__.py because loading the local llm.py replaces that package attribute.

KakaoMap is an opt-in LLM API provider. Its prompt requests transit by default and explicit walking/cycling requests; actual natural-language behavior depends on the selected LLM. Home location is the HA configured home, not a tracked phone location.

Use a stable per-entry notification ID for auth failures. Clear the matching alert only after replacement-key validation and saving succeed. Do not reveal credentials, infer expiration from an auth error alone, or treat permission/quota/network failures as expired keys. Detection occurs during requests, not periodic checks.

Keep keyword place search as the default and use the separate address tool for explicit road-name or lot-number addresses. Address and road_address objects may be null; do not invent their values or select ambiguous candidates silently. Address coordinates do not guarantee apartment unit or floor precision. LLM tool selection requires live conversation verification.

Car routing uses the separate Mobility endpoint with origin/destination in longitude,latitude order and integer result_code. Preserve transit as the travel default and RECOMMEND as the driving default; apply other priorities/avoid options only on request. Keep toll_fare separate from public-transport fare and omit upstream taxi estimates. Car map links preserve endpoints only, not routing preferences. Do not claim toll-free travel without a returned zero toll.

Resolve current location only from llm_context.context.user_id to exactly one matching person user_id; never accept caller-supplied identities or substitute another person. For state home use configured HA home coordinates; otherwise require usable person coordinates. Missing identity/link or unknown/unavailable location must request a reference location. Shared accounts identify the linked account person, not the speaker. Person state last_updated is not GPS fix freshness.

Arrival estimates use one UTC request-start instant plus each duration before conversion to HA time zone; exclude waypoint dwell time and do not claim future-departure predictions. Car waypoints preserve user order with a five-stop limit; transmit coordinates only to avoid name delimiters altering API parameters. Alternatives compare API candidates under the same conditions, preserving the primary order. Signed differences use the first candidate as baseline; no candidate means no fabricated alternative. Car links preserve ordered points, not routing preferences or a specific candidate.

Narrate subway exit/entrance numbers only when explicit in the selected route's step guidance, preserving station and entry/exit direction. Never borrow another candidate's exits or infer recommended exits from bus stop names. Transfer walking durations are already part of total duration; do not add them again or narrate their details by default.
